scope: Development reuse of all Replogle UPR targets and technical groups; nested training-target-only regularization selection, followed by actual native outer fits and independent scoring
selection: Equal-inner-target mean full-33694-gene RMSE after native-equivalent clipping; exact ties choose larger lambda
control: Original pooled controls within each gemgroup
features: All original RNA features, full-source log1p CPM, no reclosure
frozenBaseline: Original lambda 1, no change, training mean and fixed shuffle retained
primaryComparison: Each of all five gemgroups: equal-target mean full-gene RMSE versus fixed lambda 1 and training mean; retain all individual failures
outcomeReuse: Original outer outcomes and target-consistency diagnostic already inspected; this is development, not a new untouched cohort
predictionFreeze: All native outer predictions frozen before new outer scoring
